scope: Place the existing Chrome extension control over the transcript corner and persist meaningful first-prompt chat titles without replacing manual renames.

keep: Existing extension bridge and sidebar metadata authority
extend: Header disclosure positioning and first-prompt title persistence

architecture.reason: Uses existing Workspace and account history flows without a new service or model dispatch.

auth.description: Existing Chrome pairing and signed-in session remain required.

tenant.description: Existing account and repo ownership checks remain.

approval.description: No changes to browser operation approvals.

egress.description: User-initiated navigation to Chrome Web Store using the existing validated public extension ID; no prompt or credentials in the link.

cost.description: Title derivation is local; no inference cost.

tests.scope: Stable legacy title recovery and extension row layout regression.

rollout: Verify a source-pinned preview and release gates before promoting to the Workspace production site.
rollback: Revert the change or re-promote the last verified frontend build; no database migration.
knownGaps: Old sessions without a saved prompt or transcript cannot recover an exact first-prompt title until their messages are restored.
Chrome installation depends on the configured listing.

blockers: Production base has stale caller-review evidence for a pricing component not changed by this mission.
